notes: C1c-chat development pilot (PROPOSED, not approved): the grounded chat router (INCIDENT_CHAT_MODE=grounded, agent code in-process) with its default chat model nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra on Switchyard (the agent's own OpenAI-compatible client, LLM_BASE_URL), asked the 70 dev-half RA2 questions (50 incident, 20 library) on two corpora: oracle (the frozen ground truth's reports) and system (the C1b captions run's super-pipeline final reports; Burglary010 has none). 1 repeat: 140 items, at most 180 calls (an incident question 1, a library question 2). Offline estimate (prompt chars / 3 plus 1,024 output tokens a call): 527,848 tokens worst case over 179 calls; configured per-call bounds (5,000 / 2,000 / 6,000) give 820,000. Caps: 180 attempts and 600,000 tokens, hard stop. Judge cap 0: facts, holders, unsupported claims and contradictions stay pending until a judge budget is approved. References are AI-generated (163 ai_validated, 26 ai_proposed, 0 human_verified) and derived from the ground truth they are scored against (disclosed limitation).
